standard.summary: 仅保留兼容字段。当前 Anima DoRA 开启时会自动强制关闭
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Kept only as a compatibility field. It is currently forced off whenever Anima DoRA is enabled.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 仅保留兼容字段。当前 Anima DoRA 开启时会自动强制关闭；普通 Anima LoRA 默认也建议关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Compatibility field only. With current Anima DoRA enabled it is automatically forced off; plain Anima LoRA is also recommended to keep it off by default.
